label: sound
instruction_covers: full shard id layout (chain_id high 16, shard_size|shard_id low 16) and the (chain_id << 16) | shard_size | shard_id formula
Branch reporting chain id, power-of-two shard size and shard id derived from the low 16 bits only, plus the full id
is_in_branch requiring both chain equality and (low key & (shard_size-1)) shard equality
Address.get_full_shard_id combining key chain id with masked shard id and raising RuntimeError for non-power-of-two sizes
address_in_branch keeping the recipient, adopting the branch chain, and rewriting only the low shard bits while preserving higher low-key bits
notes: Repo quarkchain/core.py at base has Branch.get_shard_size/get_shard_id/is_in_shard and Address.get_shard_id/address_in_branch with no chain handling and no get_chain_id/get_full_shard_id/is_in_branch, so all chain behavior is new but fully specified. Method names follow the adjacent repo convention (get_shard_size/get_shard_id/is_in_shard, Address.get_shard_id), and Identity is already importable. Grading also runs quarkchain/tests/test_core.py; chain-0 values behave identically under the specified masking, so existing behavior is preserved.
